creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`mark_turn` (crates/muster-daemon/src/pane.rs:356) records a row number and the screen's text, and `pane read --turn` reads from there. A resize that rewraps history moves the rows. A tracked grid ref (grid_ref_tracked.h, already in the pin's C API) moves with reflow and reports when its row is pruned. It cannot cross a handover, so the row number stays as a fallback.

Inferred from the code; how often a turn's mark goes wrong in practice is not measured. Tracked refs do not replace patch 0003: a ref is lost once its row is pruned.
title: A turn's mark is a row number that rewrap moves
